predictions.why: If the opening sets the whole mode, then about 34% of answers self-open and score about 82%, and plain-mode answers score about 26%. That gives 224 = 168*0.82 + 332*0.26. Rejecting terse non-Okay answers (assuming about 43% of attempts are rejected, if about 35% of plain answers contain Wait/Hmm) and allowing up to 2 restarts raises the self-opened share of kept answers to about 0.52-0.54. Each converted problem gains about 0.56, so about 224 + 0.2*0.56*500, reduced a little for per-problem propensity and kept cap hits.
